copy_trip.body: Are you sure you want to copy this trip? Create your own copy of this trip with all its cities and bookings. You own the copy; Pro features and documents are not carried over.
delete_pro_trip.body: This is a Pro trip - the one-time upgrade you paid for will be lost. Are you sure?
delete_pro_trip.title: You are deleting a Pro trip
delete_trip.body: Are you sure you want to delete this trip? All trip data will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete_trip.title: Delete the trip
leave_trip.body: You will lose access, and your personal documents in this trip will be permanently deleted. You can return only with a new invite.
